rows.headline: Reliance Foundation Donates 21 Crore to Assam Relief Fund
rows.update: Reliance Foundation contributed Rs 21 crore to the Assam Chief Minister's Relief Fund to aid flood-affected families. The effort includes on-ground emergency relief, infrastructure restoration, and veterinary care in severely impacted districts.

rows.headline: Reliance Foundation opens scholarships for 5100 UG & PG students
rows.update: Reliance Foundation opened applications for its flagship 2026-27 scholarships to support 5,100 undergraduate and postgraduate students. The initiative aims to nurture the next generation of leaders, innovators, and changemakers contributing to India's growth story. Applications were officially announced ahead of Independence Day.

rows.headline: Reliance Industries (Kanpur Terminal) in association with Reliance Foundation, is strengthening its commitment to sustainability through tree plantations that will help nearby schools and Panchayat lands in Kanpur Dehat.
rows.update: Reliance Industries (Kanpur Terminal) partnered with Grow Billion Trees to plant native trees on school and Panchayat lands in Kanpur Dehat. The project actively engages local communities to promote agroforestry and environmental sustainability. This initiative aims to benefit future generations by turning environmental awareness into direct action.

rows.headline: From playful learning to smart Edtech, Day 2 of Building Flourishing Futures 2026, hosted by Reliance Foundation, was all about unlocking every child's potential!
rows.update: Reliance Foundation hosted the 'Building Flourishing Futures 2026' conference focused on early childhood and foundational education. The event featured discussions on literacy, numeracy, and artificial intelligence in classrooms alongside masterclasses on social-emotional learning and inclusion. Anganwadi educators and sector experts participated to share real-world insights and enhance rural educational ecosystems.

rows.headline: India's supreme court investigates Vantara zoo over endangered species
rows.update: The Supreme Court of India has formed a Special Investigation Team to investigate the Vantara animal rescue and conservation project. The investigation aims to examine how the facility, which is promoted by Reliance Industries and managed by Anant Ambani, has been acquiring its wild and endangered animals from domestic and international locations. rows.headline: Five large listed companies account for 45% of the ₹11391 crore csr pool in fy26
rows.update: An analysis published on August 8, 2026, revealed that five corporate giants drove 45 per cent of India's total CSR landscape among Nifty 50 companies during FY26. Reliance Industries was ranked as the second-largest corporate contributor with a total social spending expenditure of ₹1,223 crore. The report highlighted an overall 17 per cent year-on-year jump in social spending across the tracked corporate entities.

rows.headline: SHECONNECTS DIGITAL ACCELERATOR – INDIA FUNDING ORGANISATION
rows.update: On August 14, 2026, details regarding the SheConnects Digital Accelerator funding program in India were published, showing it as an initiative by the Reliance Foundation with support from the Gates Foundation. The program is managed on the ground by the GSMA Foundation and offers grant funding ranging from ₹85 lakh to ₹4.2 crore per project. It targets registered Indian non-profit organizations working towards women's digital inclusion, livelihoods, health, and education.

rows.headline: Reliance Foundation's prestigious Scholarships open for applications: to award 5100 first year UG & PG students
rows.update: Reliance Foundation announced the opening of applications for its flagship scholarship program for the academic year 2026–27. The initiative aims to provide financial support and mentorship to 5,000 undergraduate and 100 postgraduate first-year students across India. The scholarships provide up to Rs. 2 lakhs for undergraduate students and up to Rs. 6 lakhs for postgraduate students.

rows.headline: Responsible Businesses Take Centre Stage at 13th National CSR & ESG Summit 2026 Hosted by CSR Times
rows.update: Reliance Industries Limited was recognized as one of the prominent award winners at the 13th National CSR & ESG Summit and Awards 2026 held in New Delhi. The summit focused on the role of responsible corporations in creating scalable social impact. The award recognizes the company's outstanding commitment to driving sustainable development in India.

rows.headline: CSR Time Award 2026 - Bronze in the Skill Development category
rows.update: Reliance Industries Limited received the Bronze award at the 13th National CSR & ESG Summit 2026 for its flagship pan-India skilling initiative. The program focuses on empowering youth with industry-relevant digital learning and institutional support to enhance long-term employability. The award recognized the company's outstanding achievements in transitioning education into direct livelihood opportunities.

rows.headline: Reliance Sugar and Chemical Industries donates Rs 10 lakh
rows.update: The Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) team of Reliance Industries arranged a critical distribution drive to support residents experiencing severe flooding due to heavy monsoon rains in Vadodara. RIL volunteers successfully provided food and clean drinking water to over 5,000 flood-affected people in the rural villages of Undera and Karodia near the city. The relief program aimed to continue extending immediate outreach to more communities impacted by the severe monsoon weather.

rows.headline: Five large listed companies account for 45% of the ₹11391 crore csr pool in fy26
rows.update: Reliance Industries emerged as one of the top corporate CSR spenders in India for FY26, contributing ₹1,223 crore. Together with HDFC Bank, TCS, ICICI Bank, and State Bank of India, it accounted for over 45 per cent of the total social spending by the 46 Nifty 50 companies analyzed. The overall corporate social responsibility expenditure across these analyzed firms witnessed a 17 per cent year-on-year growth.

rows.causeFocus: Rural Transformation, Education, Health, and Disaster Response
rows.headline: A New Milestone for SPCOET! We are delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between SPCOET and Reliance Foundation.
rows.update: Reliance Foundation signed a Memorandum of Understanding with SPCOET on 4 August 2026. The partnership aims to enhance skill development, innovation, industry exposure, and career opportunities for students. It focuses on bridging the gap between academia and industry.

rows.headline: Reliance Foundation opens scholarships for 5,100 UG & PG students
rows.update: Reliance Foundation announced a new cycle of its flagship scholarships on 14 August 2026, ahead of Independence Day. The initiative will provide financial aid and capability-building support to 5,000 undergraduate and 100 postgraduate first-year students across India. The program is designed to enable talented youth to access higher education and participate in the country's economic growth.

rows.headline: Reliance Foundation Donates 21 Crore to Assam Relief Fund
rows.update: Reliance Foundation Founder and Chairperson Nita M Ambani announced a contribution of Rs 21 crore to the Assam Chief Minister's Relief Fund. This financial assistance aims to support families affected by recent severe floods in the state. The donation expands on the foundation's existing on-ground relief and rehabilitation efforts in Assam.

rows.headline: From protecting elephant corridors to reducing human-elephant conflict, we have been working to help these gentle giants thrive in the wild.
rows.update: Tata Motors has implemented Project Maximus to focus on ecological conservation. The initiative combines science-based conservation with on-ground interventions to analyze elephant habitats, conflict zones, and migration pathways. These efforts span across Jharkhand and the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve.

rows.headline: Launch of 7-Day Mahindra Pride Classroom Program at Ramchandra Chandravansi University Bishrampur, Palamu
rows.update: Ramchandra Chandravansi University successfully launched a 7-day employability skill training workshop under the Mahindra Pride Classroom initiative. Organized in collaboration with the Naandi Foundation as part of Mahindra & Mahindra's CSR efforts, the program is specifically designed to enhance career readiness, personality development, and job skills for female students.

rows.headline: Join the 40-Hour Livelihood & Employability Training Program organized by LGC's IQAC Cell & CSR Club in collaboration with Nandni Foundation and Mahindra & Mahindra.
rows.update: Ludhiana Group of Colleges organized a 40-hour certificate training course focused on essential workplace readiness and skill development. The collaborative campus program was established alongside the Naandi Foundation to nurture an entrepreneurship mindset and career growth among participating students.

rows.headline: We're honoured to share that the Mahindra Kaabil Employability Program, along with Centum Foundation CSR, has received the Mahatma Award 2024 for Gender Equality.
rows.update: The Mahindra Kaabil Employability Program, run in collaboration with Centum Foundation, was recognized at the Mahatma Awards. The program includes the Mahindra Employability Enhancement Training (EET) Programme, which has supported women across more than 250 locations in over 19 states with skill development and job placements.

rows.headline: #together | Dr.Vimal Srivastava - LinkedIn
rows.update: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd.'s FES Swaraj Division successfully completed a CSR initiative to hand over refurbished or newly developed schools to underprivileged communities. The project was carried out in collaboration with the implementing partner Manav Vikas Sansthan, along with village sarpanches and the Education Department. The formal handover of the schools took place on 6 August 2026.

rows.headline: Tata Power and IIT Bombay collaborate to accelerate innovation in clean energy and advanced power technologies
rows.update: Tata Power and IIT Bombay have signed a Master Research Agreement to establish a long-term strategic partnership for clean energy innovation. The collaboration aims to accelerate the commercialization of lab-scale innovations in next-generation energy technologies. The partnership will cover advanced research areas such as smart grids, energy storage, electric mobility, and circular economy.

rows.headline: Cisco and IIT Delhi Launch the Cisco Technology Hub to Strengthen India's AI and Cybersecurity Capabilities
rows.update: Cisco and IIT Delhi signed a Memorandum of Understanding to launch the Cisco Technology Hub on AI and Cybersecurity. Powered by Cisco's Country Digital Acceleration Program, this three-year collaboration focuses on advancing research, talent development, and workforce skilling through grants, fellowships, a chair of excellence, and specialized training programs. The initiative aims to foster innovation and co-create digital solutions for a resilient digital ecosystem in India and the Indo-Pacifi

rows.headline: IIT Kanpur, Havells India sign MoU for research, innovation in next-generation energy solutions
rows.update: IIT Kanpur and Havells India Ltd have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to collaborate on research and technological innovation in next-generation energy solutions. The partnership focuses on developing practical, scalable clean energy technologies, specifically high-efficiency Infrared (IR) cooktop systems powered directly by solar energy. This collaboration aims to support India's transition towards cleaner, resilient, and self-reliant energy systems.
